reason: A Windows-only DSH web plugin that adds a native file picker and injects selected absolute paths into the next conversation context so the agent can read the chosen files.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 添加 Windows 原生文件选择器，将用户选中的文件路径注入下一条会话上下文供智能体读取。
summaries.en: Adds a native Windows file picker to DSH Web and injects selected file paths into the next conversation context for the agent to read.

capabilities: Opens a native Windows file picker for selecting files from arbitrary local directories
Stages selected absolute paths for the next message
Injects selected paths into the conversation context for agent access through the existing read tool
